Fix compatibility with JAX 0.9.2 (#1200)

* Fix compatibility with JAX 0.9.2

JAX 0.9.2 changed Primitive.get_bind_params() to return a params dict
instead of a (subfuns, params) tuple. Subfuns (if any) are now folded
into the dict under a 'subfuns' key.

- Handle both old and new get_bind_params return types in
  finalise_eval_jaxpr via isinstance check
- Update _jvp_call_p_finalisation to accept subfuns as either
  positional args (old JAX) or keyword arg (new JAX)
- Remove dead raise_to_shaped fallback in _ad.py (already removed
  in JAX 0.8.1)

Tested on both JAX 0.8.1 (468 passed) and JAX 0.9.2 (468 passed).
